note: USACE Coralville Lake campground in the wooded dam complex just north of Iowa City, on the west side of the dam; no shoreline. The dump station and drinking water are just outside the nearby West Overlook Campground, where campers register. Woodpecker Nature Trail, the Devonian Fossil Gorge and disc golf nearby. --Claude
summary: Sites 18 -> 14 bookable (4 are management), max 64 -> 85, all back-in; hookups confirmed (50 amp; water/sewer at 4 public sites); flush toilets added; booking rec.gov, 14-night max. Not waterfront stands. Pin ~260 m off.
flags: NOT WATERFRONT STANDS: all 14 site points sit on a wooded ridge north of West Overlook Rd with no water within ~250 m on imagery; rec.gov: 'lies among a heavily wooded forest ... on the west side of the dam'. No below-dam tailwater frontage either.
PIN: stored 41.72448,-91.54323 is rec.gov's facility point, on the road by the parking area south-west of the loop; the sites centre on ~41.7254,-91.5404 (~260 m). Suggest 41.7254,-91.5404.

HOOKUPS: confirmed from the catalog (electric 50; water and sewer at 4 public sites, L04, L05, L07, L08; the others 30 or 20/30/50 amp, electric only). No non-electric site is bookable any more, so the old note's 'non-electric to full hookup' and its 18-site count are wrong.
